claim: Official March2020 working-group report records a level1 market halt on 2020-03-09 at 09:34:13 Eastern; primary reopening auctions began at 09:49:13.
impact_on_spec: Can identify documented market-halt intervals separately from unknown data gaps; any applied replay amendment must preserve signal/order/cost definitions and explicit review scope.
limitations: Does not prove each security resumed at the first permissible second; does not validate quote/fill, stop survival, boundary bars or other missing minutes.
